title: Protocol to generate large human intestinal organoids using a rotating bioreactor
protocol: Pre-coat a 6-well plate with COAT-1 coating medium.
Add 1 mL of coating medium to each well.
Incubate the plate for 30 min to 2 h at 37°C before use.
Aspirate the DEF-CS medium and rinse the cell surface with pre-warmed 2 mL PBS.
Aspirate the PBS and add 500 μL TrypLE Select.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 5–7 min.
Gently pipette the well to dissociate iPSCs to single cells.
Add 3 mL of pre-warmed iPSC medium to stop the enzymatic reaction.
Transfer the cell-suspension medium to a 15 mL STEMFULL tube.
Aliquot 20 μL of cell-suspension medium for cell count.
Seed the required cell number from the cell-suspension medium into each well.
Gently shake the plate to disperse cells evenly.
Incubate the plate in a humidified 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 16 h.
Aspirate iPSC medium and add 3 mL of pre-warmed DE day 0 medium.
Aspirate DE day 0 medium and add 3 mL of pre-warmed DE day 1 medium.
Aspirate DE day 1 medium and add 3 mL of pre-warmed DE day 2 medium.
Aspirate DE day 2 medium and add 3 mL of pre-warmed mid/hindgut medium.
Change mid/hindgut medium daily from Day 4 to Day 5.
Dissociate mid/hindgut cells differentiated from iPSCs into single cells.
Seed dissociated cells onto an ultra-low attachment spheroid-forming plate with microwells.
Generate homogeneous spheroids in suspension.
Prepare spheroid-forming medium in a volume of 3 mL per well.
Warm the prepared medium to 37°C.
Prepare an EZSPHERE® 6-well plate for use.
Add 2.5 mL of the spheroid-forming medium to each well.
Gently pipette the medium to remove bubbles within microwells.
Place the plate in a humidified 37°C, 5% CO₂ incubator before use.
Dissociate mid/hindgut cells into single cells.
Aspirate mid/hindgut medium and rinse the cell surface with pre-warmed PBS.
Add 700 μL of TrypLE Select to each well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 7 minutes.
Gently tap the plate to detach the cells.
Gently pipette mid/hindgut cells to ensure single-cell dissociation.
Add 3 mL of pre-warmed DMEM to stop the enzymatic reaction.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL STEMFULL tube.
Aliquot 20 μL of cell-suspension medium for cell count.
Centrifuge the cell suspension tube at 200 g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Calculate the volume of spheroid-forming medium to add based on the number of seeded wells (500 μL per well).
Gently mix the calculated volume of spheroid-forming medium with the cell pellet.
Add 500 μL of the prepared cell-suspension medium to each well of the EZSPHRE® 6-well plate.
Inspect and remove any bubbles from the microwells using a pipette.
Shake the plate gently to ensure even distribution of cells across all wells.
Incubate the plate in a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Avoid agitating the EZSPHERE® plates during spheroid formation as mid/hindgut cells and spheroids can easily be displaced from the microwells.
Optional: Spheroid formation can be monitored by time-lapse imaging using the BZ-X710 microscope to observe aggregation and self-organization.
Prepare mid/hindgut spheroid-forming medium (24 mL per plate) and warm it to 37°C.
Dissociate mid/hindgut cells to single cells.
Aspirate mid/hindgut medium and rinse the cell surface with pre-warmed 2 mL PBS.
Aspirate PBS and add 700 μL TrypLE Select.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 7 min.
Gently tap the plate to detach the cells.
Gently pipette mid/hindgut cells for single-cell dissociation.
Add 3 mL of pre-warmed DMEM to stop the enzymatic reaction.
Transfer the cell-suspension to a 15 mL STEMFULL tube.
Aliquot 20 μL of cell-suspension medium for cell count.
Calculate the total cell number and required well numbers.
Centrifuge the tube at 200 g for 3 min and aspirate the supernatant.
Add spheroid-forming medium to the tube and mix gently.
Place the plate in a humidified 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 24 h.
Gently shake the plate.
Pipette the medium so that spheroids float out from the microwells.
Collect the spheroid containing medium in a STEMFULL tube.
Add 1 mL of pre-warmed DMEM to each well.
Repeat steps shaking and pipetting the medium until all spheroids are collected.
Centrifuge the tube at 80 g for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Pick up s-Spheroids from individual wells using a wide tip pipette and transfer into a 15 mL STEMFULL tube.
Allow the STEMFULL tube to stand vertically for 30–60 seconds to permit gravity sedimentation of the s-Spheroids.
Aspirate the supernatant from the STEMFULL tube.
Prepare HIO d 7 medium and keep it on ice.
Add HIO d 7 medium to spheroid-collecting tube.
Transfer spheroid-suspension medium to a 6-well ultra-low attachment culture plate.
Use 3 mL of HIO d 7 medium for each well in the ULA culture plate.
Disperse the s-Spheroids by gently shaking the ULA plate.
Culture the spheroids for 3 days in a humidified 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Collect the spheroids into a 15 mL STEMFULL tube with a wide tip pipette on day 10.
Add ice-cold DMEM to the tube (up to 12 mL).
Gently rotate the tube to dislodge the spheroids from Matrigel scaffold.
For large spheroids, place the tube vertically to allow gravity sedimentation of s-Spheroids.
For small spheroids, centrifuge at 40g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat steps if there are considerable Matrigel residuals.
Add HIO medium to the tube and transfer the spheroid-suspension medium back to the ULA culture plate.
Change HIO basal medium every 3–4 days from day 13 to day 35.
Prepare 8 mL of ice-cold HIO medium.
Close the cap of the vessel.
Stand the vessel vertically on a 1.5 mL tube stand.
Add 7 mL of HIO medium to the vessel.
Add 1 mL of HIO medium to the spheroid-containing tube.
Transfer the spheroids to the vessel using a 1000 μL pipette with a cut tip.
Note: Less than 20 spheroids are cultured in a 10 mL vessel.
Set the plunger to the 10 mL scale.
Loosen the cap and release positive pressure within the vessel when setting the plunger.
Gently pipette the medium if spheroids are present close to the tip of the vessel, tilt the vessel 45 degrees, then set the plunger.
Close the cap after releasing positive pressure.
Loosen the vessel cap with an absorbent paper in hand.
Place the vessel on the CELLPET 3D-iPS® bioreactor within a humidified 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator and start rotation.
Optimize the rotational speed depending on the size of s-Spheroids/HIOs to maximize nutrient/oxygen exchange without destroying s-Spheroids/HIOs.
Collect s-Spheroids from the vessel with a 1000 μL pipette tip (with cut tip).
Transfer collected s-Spheroids to a 15 mL STEMFULL tube.
Add ice-cold DMEM to the tube up to 12 ml.
Gently rotate the tube to dislodge the spheroids from Matrigel scaffold.
Place the tube vertically to allow gravity sedimentation of spheroids.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Transfer s-Spheroids to the vessel.
Change HIO medium every 3–4 days.
Separate fused HIOs mechanically along the demarcation line using 25G needles under a stereomicroscope in a sterile condition.
Split fused s-HIOs along the demarcation line using 25G needles under a microscope.
